title: Stardust, Knowledge, Consciousness · Apart — the handover, one minute #Shorts
description:
One minute centred on the moment one energy gives way to the next. It fades up and fades away, so it can repeat without a jump.

The same three energies, but they never touch. Stardust finishes and goes quiet before Knowledge appears, and Knowledge is gone before Consciousness begins — three clear arrivals and three clear departures with nothing shared between them. This is the version where the three sounds are easiest to tell apart.

THE SAME THREE, ONE AT A TIME · D minor · 63 BPM · beatless

This is an original piece, not a cover. It was written after a reference track — А. Рыбников, «Свет звёзд», from the 1981 film «Через тернии к звёздам» — and what it borrows is an approach, not any of his material: sustained strings, a wordless voice on top, harmony that barely moves, and all of the motion in tone colour rather than in rhythm. There are no drums and no bass ostinato anywhere in it.

This is 61 seconds cut around the handover itself, found by measuring where the incoming energy overtakes the outgoing one in their separately bounced tracks rather than by trusting the written form. It fades in and out, so a replay meets silence instead of a step. The full five-minute version is on the channel.

The picture is a constant-Q spectrogram: the octave rulers run left to right from C1 to C7, so a note sits at the same place across the frame every time it is played, which a normal spectrogram does not give you. Stereo waveform below, playhead and progress across the bottom.
